addDescription: Add files and folders to the current ZIP folder, keeping their folder structure.
dropDescription: Or use the buttons below. You can keep adding more.
localNote: Your files stay in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.
folderNote: Some folder pickers omit empty folders. Drag folders here to include them.
contentsDescription: Open a folder to check its contents. Removing a folder removes everything inside it.
emptyDescription: Add files or a folder to start your ZIP.
editDescription: Changes apply to this ZIP only. Your original files stay unchanged.
entryNameError: Enter a valid name without / \ : * ? " < > |, trailing dots or spaces, or reserved system names.
nameExists: That name is already used in this folder. Choose another name.
invalidDestination: Choose an available destination outside the folder being moved.
dragHint: Drag items onto folders or the path above to move them. More actions are available in each item's menu.
name: Name
renamed: Some names were adjusted to keep every item and make paths safe to extract. Check ZIP Contents before creating your ZIP.
filenameError: Enter a filename without / \ : * ? " < > | or control characters.
compressionHint: ZIP is lossless. Images, videos and other compressed files may not get smaller.
cancelled: Cancelled. Your files are still here.
readError: The files or folder could not be read. Try adding them again with Add Files or Import Folder. Your existing contents are unchanged.
createError: The ZIP could not be created. Keep the source files available and try again, or try a smaller batch if your browser is low on memory.
memoryNote: Large ZIP files need available browser memory. You can cancel without losing your selection.
viewerLink: Open or Extract an Existing Archive
